knowledge-extraction-setup.install: Use the suma-agent entry built from this project and prepare the model configuration.
knowledge-extraction-setup.configure: Save this read-only configuration on the runner; inject the key through SUMA_MODEL_API_KEY.
knowledge-extraction-setup.register: Report the observed capability, then have an administrator register and enable its dedicated profile.
knowledge-extraction-setup.policy: This purpose analyzes only fixed sources, makes at most one model call, and exposes no tools. Capability discovery does not verify a model account or service.
